```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 5)
input_file <- "~/Desktop/Statistics_Practicum/70_grand_20250701-20260630.csv"

```


##Read in the original data

```{r read-data}
dat0 <- read.csv(input_file)

# lowercase the column names
colnames(dat0) <- tolower(colnames(dat0))
```

##Create a unique stop identifier

```{r row-id}
library(data.table)
setDT(dat0)
dat0[, row_id := .GRP, by = .(calendar_id, trip_id, geo_node_name)]

dat0 <- dat0[, .(
    trip_id = trip_id[1],
    trip_sequence = trip_sequence[1],
    block_id = block_id[1],
    block_abbr = block_abbr[1],
    route_id = route_id[1],
    route_abbr = route_abbr[1],
    route_direction_id = route_direction_id[1],
    service_type_id = service_type_id[1],
    property_tag = property_tag[1],
    geo_node_id = geo_node_id[1],
    latitude = latitude[1] / 10^7,
    longitude = longitude[1] / 10^7,
    geo_node_name = geo_node_name[1],
    public_stop_number = public_stop_number[1],
    boardings = sum(boardings),
    alightings = sum(alightings),
    arrival_time = actual_arrival_time[1],
    departure_time = actual_departure_time[1],
    adherence = adherence[1],
    date = date[1]
), by = row_id]
```



## Additional cleaning and new variables

Stop time ("dwell time") = departure_time - arrival_time, in seconds.

```{r cleaning}
library(dplyr); library(lubridate)

dat2 <- dat0 %>%
  mutate(
    date = as.Date(date),
    dwell = departure_time - arrival_time,
    arrival_hour = (arrival_time / 3600) %% 24,
    hour_bin = floor(arrival_hour),
    weekday = wday(date, label = TRUE, week_start = 1),
    day_type = ifelse(wday(date, week_start = 1) >= 6, "Weekend", "Weekday"),
    direction    = factor(route_direction_id, levels = c(7, 9), labels = c("Northbound", "Southbound")))  %>%
  #number stops before filtering
  group_by(date, trip_id) %>%
  arrange(arrival_time, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(stop_order = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup()

#removing missing values, negative times, and outliers (99th percentile)
n_start   <- nrow(dat2)
max_dwell <- quantile(dat2$dwell, 0.99, na.rm = TRUE)

dat2 %>%
  mutate(reason = case_when(
    is.na(arrival_time) | is.na(departure_time) ~ "Missing time",
    dwell < 0 ~ "Negative stop time",
    dwell > max_dwell ~ "Above 99th percentile",
    TRUE ~ "Kept")) %>%
  count(reason) %>%
  mutate(percent = round(100 * n / n_start, 2))

dat2 <- dat2 %>%
  filter(!is.na(dwell), !is.na(arrival_time), !is.na(departure_time),
         dwell >= 0, dwell <= max_dwell)

#summary of the removed data and summary of the difference between arrival and departure times
cat("Removed", n_start - nrow(dat2), "of", n_start, "rows (",
    round(100 * (n_start - nrow(dat2)) / n_start, 1), "%); dwell cutoff =",
    round(max_dwell), "seconds\n")

summary(dat2$dwell)
```

```{r theme}
#graph theme for consistency purposes

theme_pub <- theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "grey30"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    strip.text  = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

dir_cols <- c("Northbound" = "#0072B2", "Southbound" = "#D55E00")
hour_axis <- scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 23, 2), labels = function(x) sprintf("%02d:00", x))
```

```{r plot-1a}
#boxplot by hour

p1a <- ggplot(dat2, aes(x = factor(hour_bin), y = dwell)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "#9ecae1", outlier.shape = NA, linewidth = 0.4) +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, quantile(dat2$dwell, 0.95))) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 200, by = 10)) + #label every 10 seconds
  labs(title = "Stop Time by Hour of Day",
       x = "Hour of arrival", y = "Stop time (seconds)") +
  theme_pub
p1a
ggsave("fig1a_boxplot_by_hour.png", p1a, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

```{r plot-1b}
#line graph by hour and route direction

p1b <- ggplot(hourly, aes(x = hour_bin, y = median, color = direction)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = dir_cols, name = NULL) +
  hour_axis +
  expand_limits(y = c(0, 30)) + #axis covers at least 0 to 30
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 30, by = 5)) + #label every 5 seconds
  labs(title = "Median Stop Time Across Hour of Day by Direction",
       x = "Hour of arrival", y = "Stop time (seconds)") +
  theme_pub
p1b
ggsave("fig1b_median_line_by_hour.png", p1b, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
#graphs of median stop time by stop / location and route direction

get_mode <- function(x) { ux <- unique(x); ux[which.max(tabulate(match(x, ux)))] }

line_dat <- dat2 %>%
  filter(route_abbr == route_of_interest) %>%
  group_by(direction, geo_node_id, geo_node_name) %>%
  summarize(stop_order = get_mode(stop_order),
            n = n(),
            median_dwell = median(dwell),
            .groups = "drop")

#Exclude terminals (first and last stop)
line_trim <- line_dat %>%
  group_by(direction) %>%
  filter(stop_order > min(stop_order), stop_order < max(stop_order)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(n >= 20) %>%
  arrange(direction, stop_order)

#Shared y-axis
y_max  <- ceiling(max(line_trim$median_dwell, na.rm = TRUE) / 10) * 10
y_step <- ifelse(y_max <= 60, 10, 20)
y_max  <- ceiling(y_max / y_step) * y_step

make_line <- function(dir_choice) {
  d <- line_trim %>% filter(direction == dir_choice)

#making the graphs
  ggplot(d, aes(x = stop_order, y = median_dwell)) +
    geom_line(color = dir_cols[[dir_choice]], linewidth = 0.9) +
    geom_point(color = dir_cols[[dir_choice]], size = 1.8) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(2, seq(10, max(d$stop_order), by = 10)),
                       expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.02))) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, y_max),
                       breaks = seq(0, y_max, by = y_step),
                       expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.02))) +
    labs(title = paste0("Median Stop Time Along Route ", route_of_interest, " (", dir_choice, ")"),
         subtitle = "Stops shown in order of travel",
         x = "Stop number along route (first stop = 1)",
         y = "Median stop time (seconds)") +
    theme_pub +
    theme(plot.caption.position = "plot",
          plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, color = "grey30"))
}

p_nb <- make_line("Northbound")
p_nb
ggsave("fig2e_line_stop_time_northbound.png", p_nb, width = 10, height = 5, dpi = 300)

p_sb <- make_line("Southbound")
p_sb
ggsave("fig2e_line_stop_time_southbound.png", p_sb, width = 10, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```
